text: Built a memory-mapped CSV reader in Python that outperforms Pandas on single-row lookups by 980x, enabling large-scale solar dataset processing.

Engineered & benchmarked an empirical polynomial model of solar differential rotation 600x faster than SunPy (industry solar library), outperforming physics-based approach on speed & accuracy. #link("https://x.com/b_nezlobin/status/1973213855754092749")[Twitter thread.]
Wrote a file-lock scheduler that coordinated work across thousands of cores on 7–8 lab servers.
Designed and built brands, sites, and admin dashboards for Palo Alto Stanford Aquatics, G Studio, and Catalyst for Systems Change.
Cut hosting and platform costs by 95%+ versus their prior solutions, while serving >10,000 monthly users.
Conducted brand exploration & iteration; designed company voice & brand guidelines; implemented in code.
Designed, implemented, and tested pub/sub code architecture used in World Championship semifinals; one of the first successful multithreaded codebases in FIRST robotics.
Reverse-engineered the robot's control server to enable wireless real-time driving and live configuration changes.
Developed autonomous routines using camera vision and Model Predictive Control; worldwide Top-10 average.

Built _Amelia_: used voiceprint technology to understand real-world conversations and provide actionable reminders about promises to people you've talked to. First-place grand prize (\$10,000) at MongoDB Build Fest.
Built _Arbor_: Vickrey sealed-bid auction marketplace for delegating large tasks optimally across specialized AI agents. \$2,000 at Nozomio.
Built a TF-IDF search engine over congressional bills, members, and committees that answers in about 10 ms, faster than the official congress.gov API.

5,000 total users across open-source tools, apps, extensions, and games I built. My ENF work, featured by Hack Club, inspired a European patent after #link("https://www.borisnezlobin.com/writing/enf-data")[I wrote about it] on my website.
My blog has also helped reinstate life-saving suicide prevention programs and math classes in Palo Alto, read by >1,000.
Built an XR operating system on Linux that uses an iPhone as its ARKit perception engine, streaming 60 Hz SLAM poses over a custom UDP protocol.
Built and shipped _Siyi_ (siyi.app), a relationship-context app for web and iOS on Next.js, Expo/React Native, and Supabase.
Built an autonomous SEO agent loop that reads _Google Search Console_ data from scheduled runs and generates entity-foundation content pages.
Built _Semse_, a private semantic search engine over messages and email across 8+ apps, fusing dense (FAISS) and keyword (SQLite FTS5) retrieval.
Added on-device CLIP image search over photo attachments.
Co-founded _Vantage_ at UC Berkeley to build a spatial operating system with always-on on-device AI and a text API for AI agents to act through.
Built a multithreaded OpenCV pipeline to detect and track solar magnetic active regions across gigabyte-scale instrument data.
Made Bellingcat's _ShadowFinder_ geolocation CLI 3× faster with timezone-grid caching, merged upstream.
As Software Lead, built a reliability-first code architecture that delivered 100% reliable autonomous runs at the season's first tournament.
Designed and taught a robotics programming summer camp curriculum and managed the other counselors.
Built the first free, continuously updated grid-frequency (ENF) dataset for Europe, used to timestamp audio recordings; featured by _Hack Club_.
My #link("https://www.borisnezlobin.com/writing/enf-data")[writeup] on collecting the European grid's frequency inspired a European patent.
Won 3rd-place Division Inspire Award at the FTC World Championship with Kuriosity Robotics, one of the top 12 teams worldwide; qualifying took a top-4 finish among about 500 NorCal teams.
Built and run thejyv.com's publishing platform on Next.js and Cloudflare Workers for about 70 editors, making publishing 3x+ faster for non-technical staff.
Chosen as Lead Editorial Editor from about 50 founding members; edited 22 articles and run the twice-monthly editing cycle.
Moved Palo Alto Stanford Aquatics off WordPress to a custom Next.js site and CMS, cutting hosting from about \$1,200 to \$10 a year and making it far easier for staff to update.
Cut database reads about 100x with a cached article index, keeping the site inside Cloudflare's free tier.
Migrated 3+ years of the journal's published work onto the new platform.
Built _HeronScout_, an FTC scouting app used by about 50 teams on 6 continents to record 2,000+ matches (over 10,000 minutes of play).
Ran a yearlong IRB-approved computational-linguistics study predicting writing effectiveness; presented findings at Foothill College.
Labeled sentences across 7 rhetorical categories with NLI weak supervision, performing about as well as human and frontier-model annotators on most categories.
Built an OpenCV pipeline that detects polarity inversion lines, where solar flares originate, in magnetograms, and integrated magnetic flux along them.
Merged LMSAL and GOES flare lists into one 39,313-flare catalog (2010–2025) and matched every flare to its active region.
Traced a 100 MB-per-frame memory leak in movie rendering to matplotlib and filed it upstream (issue \#30400).
Built a Kalman filter that fuses AprilTag camera poses with odometry for localization, plus a log-replay tool to tune it.
Took our 18-ball autonomous routine from 2 to 15 balls scored in about a week.
Wrote the A\* field planner that drives the team's MPC path follower for automatic driving and cycling.
Built the webcam detector that finds the team's prop and picks the matching autonomous path.
Registered iPhone LiDAR scans into a 6-DoF arm's frame by fitting the arm's own shape (ICP), cutting alignment from about 87 s to 3.9 s at 3.2 mm RMSE.
Found a blocking CAN read and raised the arm's control loop from 19.4 Hz to 91.8 Hz.

Co-wrote an open letter that drew 400+ signatures, spoke to the school board, and met members one on one; two changed their votes and multivariable calculus was reinstated, now serving 45+ students a year.

Investigated seven student rail suicides and argued the volunteer Track Watch program outperformed the district's thermal-camera plan; quoted at a school board meeting and reprinted in the school paper.
Placed 38th at NPDL Nationals in policy debate and taught persuasive speaking for 80+ volunteer hours.
Built _maras_, a trustless on-chain marketplace for mined vanity contract-address salts, using a commit-reveal scheme to sell information that loses its value once revealed; deployed on Base Sepolia.
Ran the team's budget and sponsorships as captain, landing free filament and hardware discounts and finishing the season at a net profit.

Built _Deslop_, a browser extension that scores posts against about 20 heuristics for LLM house style and collapses the ones that read as machine-written, tuned so ordinary human posts stay clear of the threshold.
